Japan's Centenarian Population Surpasses 100,000 for First Time

For the first time in history, the number of people aged 100 or older in Japan has exceeded 100,000. The latest figures indicate that 88% of these centenarians are women. This demographic milestone occurs as Japan's overall population continues to age and shrink.
